title: Publish ICARUS quickstart and reset local installation for a personal trial
owner: ICARUS README; Da-vinci public product host; task-owned local test installations

evidence: Published README matches source and was checked in Chrome. All five binary platforms, installation, local save/recall, upgrade, optional developer email/Google sign-in and fifteen-minute terminal recovery documented.
ICARUS product host now renders ICARUS rather than the general marketing homepage. Install anchor, title after hydration, rendered commands and optional login text verified in Chrome.
Setup prompt removes mandatory Harness initialization; docs use .icarus paths and identify the Python source build. Experimental Bus/Computer Use remain separate.
Guarded Worker release from promoted current main; newer provider-banner source preserved through reconciliation before cutover. No backend/Runtime/Brain deployment.
Three host-routing tests and one rendered onboarding test passed. Two older AI discovery tests fail identically on the unchanged baseline.
Public root HTTP 200, main JavaScript 200 text/javascript, missing JS 404 text/plain, setup prompt 200 text/markdown.

Installer verified in a separate HOME against published v0.3.91: checksum/version plus the documented account-free local save/recall example passed. Host launchctl calls were intercepted; fixture daemon stopped.

No global installation, binary, managed shell PATH entry, launchd service, global MCP registration, hook, standing instruction or ICARUS skill existed at inventory. The residual test daemon was stopped and thirteen task-owned temporary installation/test directories removed.
Seven test homes and the installer fixture were archived to a private local backup. All backup directories 0700/files 0600. Source repositories and project-local memory/configuration preserved.
Fresh login shell confirmed no icarus command, and launchd/MCP absence was verified before returning the installer command to the user. No further cleanup or reinstallation runs after that handoff.

limitations: No social posts published; announcement drafting is a separate requested deliverable.
Existing browser/server identity sessions were preserved; this reset concerns local installation and test data.
